sources.title: Peter L. Bartlett, Dylan J. Foster, and Matus Telgarsky, Spectrally-normalized margin bounds for neural networks
sources.source_kind_detail: Full 24-page PDF copy of the arXiv preprint with appendix
sources.locator: Definition (1.2); §3.1; Lemmas 3.1–3.2; Theorem 1.1; Appendix A.2–A.7, especially A.3–A.7.

contents.name: §3.2 covering-number convention
contents.support: The local definition spells out finite proper centers and the least-cover convention in Frobenius norm.

contents.name: Definition (1.2), reference-matrix spectral complexity
contents.support: The local definition fixes the mixed (2,1) transpose-difference norm, reference matrices, and spectral product convention while stating the vector-valued zero-origin Lipschitz architecture explicitly.

contents.name: Appendix A.3, truncated Dudley integral
contents.support: The assigned carrier supplies a complete local dyadic chaining proof, including the zero-anchor translation and finite maximum estimate.

contents.name: §3.1 and Appendix A.2, multiclass margin and ramp
contents.support: The local definition fixes the multiclass tie convention, zero-one error, bounded ramp, population risk, and empirical threshold loss.

contents.name: Lemma 3.2 and Appendix A.4, Maurey matrix-product cover
contents.support: The local proof derives signed rank-one atoms, expected approximation error, and the nearest-point projection to proper centers.

contents.name: Appendix A.2, uniform loss-class deviation
contents.support: The local proof supplies measurability, ghost-sample symmetrization, and two bounded-difference steps; it does not import an unproved Rademacher theorem.

contents.name: Lemma 3.1 and Appendix A.5, layerwise entropy induction
contents.support: The local induction propagates activation errors, verifies transposed operator norms via SVD, and optimizes the layer allocation.

contents.name: Theorem 1.1 and Appendix A.6, fixed spectral caps
contents.support: The local calculation derives the entropy coefficient 20, the truncated integral, and the resulting constants 8 and 36 sqrt(20).

contents.name: Theorem 1.1 and Appendix A.7, simultaneous margin and norm discretization
contents.support: The local countable union uses two-sided gamma bins and explicit positive confidence logarithms to avoid the printed bin-direction mismatch.

contents.name: Theorem 1.1, numerical one-layer specialization
contents.support: The example evaluates the local theorem for one point mass and states its loose n=1 right-hand side.

contents.name: Definition (1.2), reference-matrix variation
contents.support: The example changes only the chosen reference matrix and computes the resulting complexity values.

contents.name: Theorem 1.1, finite-sample limitation illustration
contents.support: The example checks a two-label distribution against the theorem’s explicit 8/n correction.

read_evidence.inspection: Complete full arXiv PDF inspected. Read Definition (1.2), §3.1, Lemmas 3.1–3.2, Theorem 1.1, and the complete relevant Appendix A.2–A.7 arguments. Printed pp. 21–23 were visually checked for the A.7 dyadic-bin direction.
